caption: The drawing depicts a traditional outfit consisting of a knee-length pleated skirt and a matching long-sleeved jacket, both made from a tartan-patterned fabric in shades of brown, beige, blue, and red, with the pattern forming a grid of rectangles. The jacket is open at the front to reveal a brown waistcoat beneath, buttoned with six metallic buttons, each having a decorative design. The waistcoat extends slightly below the jacket. The cuffs of the sleeves and the lower part of the jacket, as well as the exposed portions of the waistcoat, are a solid brown color, contrasting with the patterned fabric. The skirt is full and pleated, and the background is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or details. There is no head, hands, or feet shown in the image.
title: Boy's Poplin Suit
